meta.premiseEvidence: Synchronized source 2e35f3d, current SOUL/Game Loop files, current draw/perk/archetype code, managed-agent branch review, and S159 release evidence prove three bounded repository-owned gaps.

gameLoopReview.evidenceBoundary: Structural scores only; no participant fun, balance, satisfaction, or retention claim.

axisCoverage.feature depth & refinement: Make the existing threat and doctrine systems authoritative at the player decision point.
axisCoverage.innovation: Project local state into a bounded player-relative compass and prospective doctrine receipt.
axisCoverage.ui / ux / user-experience: Preserve edge readability under zoom and preview perk consequences before commitment.
axisCoverage.feedback loop: Expose grouped threat priority and exact doctrine milestone deltas.
axisCoverage.gamification / engagement / immersion: Strengthen readable chaos and improvised doctrine without adding grind.
axisCoverage.ai / intelligence integration: Use deterministic pure projections with reasoned evidence rather than hosted inference.
axisCoverage.security: Add no identity, network, export, secret, or untrusted-data boundary.
axisCoverage.speed / organization / efficiency: Centralize geometry and delta policy and refresh protocol-readable loop truth.
axisCoverage.token / api cost reduction: Use existing runtime/UI paths with zero dependency or per-player cost.

items.why: Threat arrows are projected from viewport center, emitted one-per-enemy, and painted inside the world/aim-down-sights transform, so zoom and burst spawns can defeat their readability contract.
items.recipe: Transform enemies around the live player focus, project rays from that player to an inset screen rectangle, aggregate bounded direction groups, preserve boss/elite/Fog-of-War policy, and render after world transforms with visible counts.
items.measurement: Zoomed and unzoomed fixtures agree on direction; arrows remain within inset bounds; a burst emits at most eight groups; boss/elite priority survives grouping; draw order is screen-space; focused pixels pass at 390 and 1440.

items.why: Perk choices show static archetype affinity but not the count or capstone/doctrine/mastery boundary the selection will cross.
items.recipe: Compute all candidate deltas from active perks with one pure contract, choose the most significant visible delta deterministically, render concise accessible progress/milestone copy, and preserve all input paths.
items.measurement: Duplicate/unknown perks fail closed; shared perks resolve deterministically; forming, capstone, doctrine, and mastery crossings are tested; component and mobile/desktop pixels pass.

items.why: Protocol and public Game Loop sources still describe only standard waves and omit authored Operations, proximity, route consequences, local score evidence, and current replay boundaries.
items.recipe: Synchronize both files around the standard/Operation split, defeat/rematch loop, current evidence paths, and explicit unavailable evidence.
items.measurement: Both sources name the same two run grammars, evidence boundaries, and failure/recovery paths; public wording remains acronym-safe and proprietary-safe.

Pure prospective archetype deltas, deterministic milestone selection, accessible modal copy, fail-closed tests, and mobile-contained rendered pixels pass.

Focused before/after matrix 96/96; hosted route/theme/viewport matrix 1020/1020; staging alias and immutable deployment each pass 7/7 live checks; CANON-053 passes with 14 hash-bound captures.
